info.title: Astrea API
info.description: Computes accessibility-aware itineraries for ASTREA's Beta Test Plan. Call GET /v0/auth/anonymous to obtain a token, then send it as the access-token header on every other request.

get.description: This endpoint is public: no `access-token` header is required. The returned token must be sent as the `access-token` header on every other request. Tokens are kept in memory and are lost when the API restarts.

202.description: A new anonymous access token was generated.

400.description: The request could not be processed.

schema.description: Error body returned for client errors (400 and 422), with a readable message.
Error body returned for 500 Internal Server Error responses.

post.summary: Compute an itinerary between two points.

requestBody.description: Start/end points and the mobility profile to route for.

400.description: The request body is invalid, or an address cannot be found.

schema.description: Error body returned for client errors (400 and 422), with a readable message.

401.description: The access-token header is missing or invalid.

422.description: A point is outside the area covered by the map, or no route matches the mobility profile.

schema.description: Error body returned for client errors (400 and 422), with a readable message.
Error body returned for 500 Internal Server Error responses.

get.summary: List the standard wheelchairs and the accessibility reference values.
get.description:
Requires the `access-token` header (see `GET /v0/auth/anonymous`).
Use it to build the wheelchair selector, then send the chosen model's
`recommended_wheelchair_width` as `wheelchair_width` to `POST /v0/itinerary`.
All dimensions are in meters.

401.description: The access-token header is missing or invalid.

schema.description: Error body returned for 500 Internal Server Error responses.

min_passage_width.description: Minimum free passage width, in meters.

recommended_corridor_width.description: Recommended free passage width in corridors, in meters.

turning_circle_diameter.description: Diameter of the circle needed to turn around, in meters.

AccessibilityStandardsResponse.description: Spatial accessibility reference values, in meters.

start.description: The starting point: either coordinates as `"lat,lng"` with `.` as the decimal separator, or a free-text address geocoded through Nominatim.

end.description: The destination point, in the same formats as `start`.

mobility_profile.description: The user's mobility profile. Conditions the relevance of the other fields.

wheelchair_width.description: Wheelchair width in meters. Applies to the Wheelchair profile. The returned path is guaranteed to be wider than this value.

physical_strength.description: Physical strength of a wheelchair user. Applies to the Wheelchair profile. Determines tolerance to slopes and slightly raised curbs.

is_accompanied.description: Whether the user is accompanied. Applies to the Wheelchair and Blind profiles. Wheelchair: allows gentle slopes even without physical strength. Blind: if not accompanied, a tactile paving path becomes mandatory.

can_climb_stairs.description: Whether a person on crutches can climb stairs. Applies to the Crutches profile. true: stairs are acceptable (but not too many/too high). false: no stairs, no raised curbs.

path_preferences.description: Route preferences for an able-bodied pedestrian. Applies to the Pedestrian profile. Example: `LitStreets | Benches` = 24.

error.description: Human-readable description of what was wrong with the request.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body returned for client errors (400 and 422), with a readable message.

points.description: The computed route, as an ordered list of points from start to end.

MobilityProfile.description: The user's mobility profile. Determines which optional fields on `CreateItineraryRequest` are relevant. (0 = Pedestrian, 1 = Wheelchair, 2 = Crutches, 3 = Blind)

PathPreference.description: Route preferences for able-bodied pedestrians. Combinable bit flags, e.g. `LitStreets | Benches` = 24. Bitmask: Stairs=1, Slopes=2, WidePathways=4, LitStreets=8, Benches=16. Combine with bitwise OR, e.g. LitStreets | Benches = 24.

PhysicalStrength.description: Physical strength level, used for wheelchair users. Determines tolerance to slopes and slightly raised curbs. (0 = Low, 1 = Medium, 2 = High)

error.description: Human-readable error message. Do not rely on its exact wording.

errorId.description: Unique identifier for this error. Quote it to the backend team when reporting an issue: it identifies the corresponding entry in the `error_logs` MongoDB collection.

ServerErrorResponse.description: Error body returned for 500 Internal Server Error responses.

accessToken.description: The anonymous access token. Send it as the `access-token` header on every other request.

items.description: A wheelchair category and its standard models.

categories.description: The wheelchair categories (manual, electric), each with its standard models.

accessibility_standards.description: Reference values for designing navigable routes and spaces.

id.description: Stable identifier of the category, to use as a translation key on the client.

name.description: English display name of the category.

items.description: A standard wheelchair model (brand and range) with its overall dimensions.

models.description: The standard models of this category.

WheelchairCategoryResponse.description: A wheelchair category and its standard models.

id.description: Stable identifier of the model. Store this, not the label, to remember the user's choice.

range.description: Product ranges covered by this entry.

length.description: Overall length range, in meters. Informational: the engine does not use it yet.

recommended_wheelchair_width.description: Width in meters to send as `wheelchair_width` to `POST /v0/itinerary`. It is the widest chair of the range, so the returned path fits every chair of the range.

WheelchairModelResponse.description: A standard wheelchair model (brand and range) with its overall dimensions.

accessToken.description: Anonymous access token obtained from GET /v0/auth/anonymous. Send it as the access-token header on every other request.
accessToken.name: access-token
